claim.claim-text: 2. The computer-implemented method of claim 1, further comprising generating, as the binding of each attachment element, a hash value using a cryptographic function and the digital signature of the set of data.
3. The computer-implemented method of claim 1, further comprising generating, as the binding of each attachment element, a hash value using a cryptographic function the attestation token.
4. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein each attachment element comprises a resource locator for the recipient for which the attachment element is generated.

5. The computer-implemented method of claim 4, wherein each attachment element comprises an attachment element digital signature generated using a private key of the client device and a combination of the binding of the attachment element, the recipient data of the attachment element, and the resource locator.
6. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein the set of data comprises a token creation timestamp that indicates a time at which the attestation token is created.
7. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein the attestation token comprises a public key of the client device.
8. The computer-implemented method of claim 7, further comprising generating the digital signature the set of data using a private key of the client device.
9. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein the set of data comprises a device integrity token comprising a verdict indicating whether the client device is trusted.

10. The computer-implemented method of claim 9, wherein the device integrity token comprises a timestamp indicating when an integrity system generated the device integrity token based on an evaluation of fraud detection signals obtained from the client device.

11. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein the set of data comprises an application integrity token comprising a verdict indicating whether an application running on the client device is trusted.

12. The computer-implemented method of claim 11, wherein the application integrity token comprises a timestamp indicating when an integrity system generated the application integrity token based on an evaluation of fraud detection signals obtained from the client device.

13. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein sending, by the client device, the communication that includes the attestation token and the attachment elements to at least one recipient comprises sending the communication to a primary recipient configured to remove at least some of the attachment elements from the attestation token before sending the attestation token to the multiple recipients.

one or more processors (610); and one or more storage devices (630) storing instructions that, when executed by the one or more processors (610), cause the one or more processors (610) to carry out the method of any preceding claim.

15. A computer readable storage medium carrying instructions that, when executed by one or more processors (610), cause the one or more processors (610) to carry out the method of any one of claims 1 to 13.
